title: Daddy Loses his Glasses
note: 英文人工 SRT 与中文翻译逐条对齐；纯音效/水印行已剔除。

lines.en: I'm Peppa Pig.
lines.zh: 我是佩奇。

lines.en: This is my little brother George.
lines.zh: 这是我的弟弟乔治。

lines.en: This is Mummy Pig.
lines.zh: 这是猪妈妈。

lines.en: And this is Daddy Pig.
lines.zh: 这是猪爸爸。

lines.en: Peppa Pig.
lines.zh: 小猪佩奇。

lines.en: Daddy loses his glasses.
lines.zh: 爸爸的眼镜掉了。

lines.en: Daddy Pig wears glasses.
lines.zh: 猪爸爸戴眼镜。

lines.en: He needs to wear glasses to see clearly.
lines.zh: 他需要戴眼镜才能看得清楚。

lines.en: When Daddy Pig wears his glasses, everything looks fine.
lines.zh: 当猪爸爸戴上眼镜时，一切看起来都很好。

lines.en: But when Daddy Pig takes his glasses off,
lines.zh: 但是当猪爸爸摘下眼镜时，

lines.en: he can't see things clearly.
lines.zh: 他看不清东西。

lines.en: Everything looks a bit soft and fuzzy.
lines.zh: 一切看起来都有点柔软和模糊。

lines.en: So it is very important that Daddy Pig knows where his glasses are.
lines.zh: 所以猪爸爸知道他的眼镜在哪里非常重要。

lines.en: Sometimes Daddy Pig loses his glasses.
lines.zh: 有时猪爸爸的眼镜会掉。

lines.en: Peppa, George, have you seen Daddy Pig's glasses?
lines.zh: 佩奇乔治，你看到猪爸爸的眼镜了吗？

lines.en: He can't find them anywhere.
lines.zh: 他在任何地方都找不到它们。

lines.en: No, Mummy.
lines.zh: 不，妈妈。

lines.en: Peppa and George do not know where Daddy Pig's glasses are.
lines.zh: 佩奇和乔治不知道猪爸爸的眼镜在哪里。

lines.en: Oh, dear.
lines.zh: 哦，亲爱的。

lines.en: Daddy Pig cannot see a thing without them and it makes him very grumpy.
lines.zh: 猪爸爸没有它们就看不到任何东西，这让他非常脾气暴躁。

lines.en: Without his glasses on, Daddy Pig cannot read his newspaper.
lines.zh: 猪爸爸不戴眼镜就看不到报纸。

lines.en: This is ridiculous.
lines.zh: 这太荒谬了。

lines.en: I can't see anything.
lines.zh: 我什么也看不见。

lines.en: Somebody must have put my glasses somewhere.
lines.zh: 一定有人把我的眼镜放在什么地方了。

lines.en: Do you remember where you last put them, Daddy Pig?
lines.zh: 猪爸爸，你还记得上次把它们放在哪里吗？

lines.en: When I don't wear them, I always put them in my pocket.
lines.zh: 当我不戴的时候，我总是把它们放在口袋里。

lines.en: But they aren't there now.
lines.zh: 但他们现在不在那里。

lines.en: Daddy, can we help find your glasses?
lines.zh: 爸爸，我们可以帮你找眼镜吗？

lines.en: Good idea, Peppa.
lines.zh: 好主意，佩奇。

lines.en: If you find them, Daddy will stop being so grumpy.
lines.zh: 如果你找到了他们，爸爸就不再那么脾气暴躁了。

lines.en: I'm not grumpy.
lines.zh: 我不脾气暴躁。

lines.en: Peppa and George are looking for Daddy's glasses.
lines.zh: 佩奇和乔治正在寻找爸爸的眼镜。

lines.en: Peppa looks under the newspaper, but Daddy Pig's glasses are not there.
lines.zh: 佩奇往报纸下面一看，猪爸爸的眼镜不见了。

lines.en: Oh.
lines.zh: 哦。

lines.en: George looks on top of the television, but Daddy Pig's glasses are not there.
lines.zh: 乔治看着电视上方，但猪爸爸的眼镜不在那里。

lines.en: Oh.
lines.zh: 哦。

lines.en: Let's look upstairs at Mummy and Daddy's bedroom.
lines.zh: 我们去楼上看看妈妈和爸爸的卧室。

lines.en: Peppa and George are looking in Mummy and Daddy Pig's bedroom.
lines.zh: 佩奇和乔治正在妈妈和猪爸爸的卧室里找。

lines.en: George, be careful not to knock anything over.
lines.zh: 乔治，小心别碰翻任何东西。

lines.en: It's not funny.
lines.zh: 这不好笑。

lines.en: Peppa looks under the pillows, but Daddy Pig's glasses are not there.
lines.zh: 佩奇往枕头底下看，但猪爸爸的眼镜不见了。

lines.en: Oh.
lines.zh: 哦。

lines.en: George looks in Daddy's slippers, but the glasses are not there either.
lines.zh: 乔治看了爸爸的拖鞋，但眼镜也不在了。

lines.en: Let's look in the bathroom.
lines.zh: 我们去浴室看看吧。

lines.en: Peppa and George are looking in the bathroom.
lines.zh: 佩奇和乔治正在浴室里看。

lines.en: The glasses are not in the bath.
lines.zh: 眼镜不在浴缸里。

lines.en: Oh.
lines.zh: 哦。

lines.en: The glasses are not in the toilet.
lines.zh: 眼镜不在厕所里。

lines.en: Oh.
lines.zh: 哦。

lines.en: It's too difficult.
lines.zh: 太难了。

lines.en: Peppa and George cannot find Daddy Pig's glasses anywhere.
lines.zh: 佩奇和乔治到处都找不到猪爸爸的眼镜。

lines.en: We've looked everywhere, but we can't find Daddy's glasses.
lines.zh: 我们到处都找遍了，就是找不到爸爸的眼镜。

lines.en: Oh, dear. Now what can we do?
lines.zh: 哦，亲爱的。现在我们能做什么？

lines.en: I suppose I'll just have to learn to do without them.
lines.zh: 我想我只需要学会没有它们就可以了。

lines.en: If I move slowly, I won't bump into things.
lines.zh: 如果我动作慢一点，就不会撞到东西。

lines.en: There they are! Daddy's glasses!
lines.zh: 他们在那里！爸爸的眼镜！

lines.en: Daddy Pig, you were sitting on them all the time.
lines.zh: 猪爸爸，你一直坐在他们身上。

lines.en: Oh.
lines.zh: 哦。

lines.en: Silly Daddy.
lines.zh: 傻爸爸。

lines.en: I don't know how they got there.
lines.zh: 我不知道他们是怎么到那里的。

lines.en: I wonder how.
lines.zh: 我不知道怎么办。

lines.en: Well, you may have been a bit silly, Daddy Pig,
lines.zh: 好吧，你可能有点傻了，猪爸爸，

lines.en: but at least you're not grumpy any more.
lines.zh: 但至少你不再脾气暴躁了。

lines.en: I was not grumpy.
lines.zh: 我并不脾气暴躁。
